home.title: About
home.body:
# RUNOX

electrical engineer · game developer · world-builder · artist

I build things at the edge of hardware and imagination. Circuits that do something clever. Games that pull you into worlds I've been constructing for years. Art that doesn't explain itself.

This place — REQUIEM — is my corner of the internet. It only reveals itself to those who look. You found it. Welcome.
